subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a generic bearer-authenticated Gateway context-engine control API with plugin-owned status, doctor, and rotate hooks?
rationale: This is a new remote operator control surface plus public context-engine plugin API, so automation cannot decide the permanent security and product boundary from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Accept after hardening
options.body: Keep the core API shape but require the failure handling, SDK exports, docs, and merge-conflict refresh before merge.

options.title: Narrow the surface
options.body: Move this behind a more specific plugin-owned or admin-only integration until a concrete first client proves the generic core API is needed.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Hold or close this direction until a maintainer sponsors the control-plane use case and permanent contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after hardening
recommendation.body: Keep the core API shape but require the failure handling, SDK exports, docs, and merge-conflict refresh before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mostly about Gateway operator API/security scope, where recent merged method-scope and protocol work points to steipete as the best available owner.
